demos.name: Ping Gateway Route LAB (simulated)
demos.description: Simulated evaluator, not real PingGateway: which route a request matches and why, the empty-first-param WWW-Authenticate bug, RFC 9728 metadata lint and an RFC 7662 introspection stub. Mock mode only; Live is refused for now.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5050). Mock only: no tenant, no gateway, no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=5050 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is relative to the demo root (the folder above this checkout) and names the repo folder ping-gateway-route-LAB. catalogId A19 is carried over from the old repo and is a placeholder until the owner confirms the catalog row.
